description: Embeddable RemoteWebViewService. Host the relay server inside your own process (for example a WPF or WinForms app) with RemoteWebViewServer.StartAsync, or run it standalone with RemoteWebViewServer.Run.
releaseNotes:
Based on maui 10.0.15.1

Changes since 10.0.14
Merge branch 'claude/session-bar-opt-in': session bar is opt-in, templates, restart keeps the owner role (10.0.15.1)
A page comes back from a restart with the query it was opened with
Session bar is opt-in: no placeholder, no bar; a template makes it the app's own
Merge branch 'claude/session-bar-slot-declared': session bar waits for a declared placeholder (10.0.15.1)
Generator README and ShareControl doc comment mention the host-page tag for the session bar
Version 10.0.15.1 (was 10.0.16): the first three parts follow the .NET release
Test: visibility waits take their own options type
Session bar waits for a declared placeholder instead of floating at startup (10.0.16)
Release workflow publishes to NuGet when dry_run is off (trusted publishing, nuget-org approval)
10-client test waits 2 minutes before attaching browsers again (idle sessions must survive)
Server stats tests: the app's own blazor.modules.json is served now (2 bytes fewer per client)
ParticipantsChanged needs relay 10.0.15
Merge PR #85 (module, JS, relay, lifecycle, generator and system test fixes)
README and release notes: sign-in providers, owner key, ParticipantsChanged
Authorization is injected, not compiled in: None, Fake (tests) and AzureB2C providers
Tests: owner URL carries the key; spoofed-owner test waits for the roster
WinForms: OwnerKey is not a designer property
WIP: owner key, names in the roster, ParticipantsChanged, session group check
Remove UTF-8 BOM from embedded blazor.modules.json and clear CS8602 warnings
Use bundled protoc 3.x binary in scripts/protoc.js on Linux CI
Fix bugs across module, JS, relay, lifecycle, generator, and system tests
Browser swarm keeps 300 separate clients, spread over 10 Chromium processes
Fix RunTests.ps1 packaging/tool issues, concurrent browser tests, and MSB3277 warnings
RunTests: -NoBuild runs the tests on what the last run built
Lost-connection test cuts the viewer's connections itself
A lost connection is shown and a /mirror page comes back; unattended hand-over retried; frames follow the latest control change
Web.JS test file as EditWebView writes it
EditWebView keeps this repository's own changes across a run
Upstream source from MAUI 10.0.130 and aspnetcore 10.0.15 (EditWebView run)
Document EditWebView in the release process.
EditWebView: ask for tag dates only on the wanted major version, and print progress
EditWebView prints what a run changed; Web.JS/src and test no longer git-ignored
update packages
EditWebView: fall back to the GitHub CLI sign-in when GITHUB_PAT is not set
Microsoft 10.0 libraries to 10.0.15, SDK 10.0.404; EditWebView re-applies the Web.JS patches
Control test: a browser that has not been told yet is 'not agreed', not an error
Restart test: wait for the restart to start before waiting for the page to return
RunTests: -Filter for a partial browser run; restart test keeps the bar in view
Agent: hand the requester the session's join link
Generator: voice, run-time choices, app-supplied startup values, and a restart that survives a stuck window
Library: a restart request still restarts an app whose UI thread is stuck
Session bar: opt-in Restart button
Shared control: one change of controller at a time
Voice: a mirror page gets the remote end whenever nobody holds it
Relay: every write to the app's stream goes through one guarded method
Shared control: a message from before a hand-off can no longer replace a real one
RunTests: quote the -p: switch so PowerShell passes it whole
RunTests: run every test project, quick suites first
BugBountyTests: the mirror-scroll test ignores the control notices browsers are now sent
ControlTransferTests: the fake browser stream accepts the relay's token overload
Tests for sharing control: relay policy, render acks, URL loading, and end-to-end browser tests

Full list: https://github.com/budcribar/RemoteBlazorWebView/compare/10.0.14...227d88ffc73906e1f5d6999da10e6962b1fe51cb
